newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds trade picks up on Sparks data.
newsitem.headline: European feeds trade picks up on Sparks data.

text.p: The European meals and feeds market saw some activity this afternoon on expectations of a firmer Chicago soycomplex futures opening on the back of bullishly interpreted crop data by private forecaster Sparks, market sources said.

Sparks Companies on Tuesday pegged 1997 U.S. soybean acreage at 67.5 million acres and corn at 81.9 million acres compared to last week's USDA figures of 68.8 million and 81.4 million acres respectively.
Sparks also put the 1996/97 and 97/98 U.S. soybean ending stocks below USDA's figures.
Sparks pegged the 1996/97 ending stocks at 115 million bushels and 97/98 stocks at 123 million against USDA's 130 and 240 million bushels.

"Operators here expected Chicago futures to rise on the Sparks figures and bought some, mostly nearby, soy and sunmeal despite the high dollar wich put a lid on demand for most other products," one broker said.

Spot Argentine soymeal pellets traded at $280 a tonne fob Rotterdam, afloat changed hands at $277 a tonne cif and May at $278.50 cif. July/Sept Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $123 and Oct/Dec at $129 a tonne cif.--KAREL LUIMES +31 20 504 5832
